credd.t: Supplementary card triggers a 10% earn-rate bonus
credd.v: 10% bonus earn rate added to the existing card accelerator when a supplementary card is on the account (accelerated 5 pts/$1 earns 5.5; base 1 pt/$1 earns 1.1)
credd.cond: Per BMO's terms the benefit applies to transactions made by BOTH the primary cardholder and its authorized user(s) — it is a rate boost on all account earn, not a bonus on the supplementary card's own spend. Labelled an 'introductory feature' and subject to change. Authorized-user eligibility per the terms: at least 13 years old, primary account activated before the user is added, Canadian address for correspondence, not in the primary cardholder's own name, not already on the account, fewer than 9 authorized users on the account, not in a business name. The accelerator it boosts is capped per category on a Jan 1–Dec 31 basis (gas/grocery/dining/transit).

credd.v: $50 statement credit each annual period
credd.cond: Requires a single purchase of $50 or more during the annual period; credited within two statement cycles after the account anniversary (annual-fee renewal) date, account open and in good standing. Product transfers out and back, or cancel-and-reapply within the same annual period, do not earn a second credit.

insl.med: Out-of-province emergency travel medical up to $5,000,000 per insured person per trip; 15 days if age 64 or under on departure date, 3 days if age 65 or over. No card charge required; coverage starts on departure from the home province, unlimited trips per year, each separated by a return home. Assistance/claims via Global Excel
insl.trip: Trip Cancellation: up to $1,500 per insured person per trip (maximum $5,000 per trip for all insured persons combined) for non-refundable, non-transferable prepaid travel arrangements. Trip Interruption and Trip Delay: up to $2,000 per insured person per trip. Coverage period runs from when any portion of the trip costs is first charged to the card. Pre-existing condition stability requirement in the trip certificate: flat 90 days before the effective date (cancellation) or departure date (interruption/delay)
insl.fd: Flight Delay: up to $500 per occurrence for all insured persons combined when a confirmed flight is delayed 4+ hours (fare charged to the card or obtained by redeeming card reward points); entertainment expenses sub-limited to $100 combined
insl.bag: Delay of Checked Baggage (6+ hours): up to $500 per insured person, maximum $1,000 per occurrence combined. Lost or Stolen Baggage: up to $500 per insured person, maximum $1,000 per occurrence combined
insl.cdw: Car Rental Collision/Loss Damage: theft, loss or damage to a rental car with MSRP up to $85,000, rental period up to 48 consecutive days; no deductible; primary insurance. Full rental cost must be charged to the card and the agency CDW/LDW must be declined. insl.trip: Trip Cancellation and Interruption (Desjardins family contract; the card page lists cancellation and 'Unlimited Trip Interruption'): true pre-departure cancellation up to $2,000 per trip per insured person; delayed departure / missed connection up to $2,000; travel supplier default up to $2,000; early or delayed return (interruption) unlimited; eligible expenses are those prepaid with the card
insl.fd: Not offered as a standalone benefit; delayed departure / missed connection is covered under Trip Cancellation (up to $2,000)
insl.bag: Baggage (Desjardins family contract): theft or damage up to $1,000 per trip per insured person ($500 per item and $500 per category-group sub-limits; $250 for document replacement); late delivery up to $500 when checked baggage is delayed more than 6 hours, for essentials only (a delay payment is deducted from any later loss payment)
insl.cdw: Auto Rental Collision/Loss Damage Insurance (Assurant certificate): rentals up to 48 consecutive days (a rental over 48 days has no coverage at all); vehicles with an MSRP over $65,000 excluding taxes at the time of loss are not covered; the rental must be booked, guaranteed and paid in full with the card, in the cardholder's name, and the rental agency's CDW/LDW must be declined; covered drivers are the cardholder and any licensed driver with the cardholder's express permission, including drivers not listed on the rental contract; excludes luxury, specialty and exotic vehicles, trucks and pickup trucks, vans other than minivans (maximum 8 occupants, private use), campers, trailers and RVs, off-road vehicles, motorcycles and mopeds, customized vehicles, antique vehicles (20+ years old or model out of production 10+ years), leased vehicles and tax-free cars
insl.pp: Purchase Protection (Assurant certificate): 90 days from purchase for loss, theft or damage, anywhere in the world; up to $10,000 per item and a $50,000 lifetime maximum per account; coverage is excess over other valid insurance; reimbursement is capped at the purchase price charged to the card, so a partial charge caps recovery at the amount charged; gifts are covered
insl.ew: Extended Warranty (Assurant certificate): doubles the manufacturer's warranty, up to 1 additional year; only items with an original warranty of 5 years or less are eligible; up to $10,000 per item and a $50,000 lifetime maximum per account; excess over other coverage; no registration requirement is stated in the certificate
insl.mob: Mobile Device Insurance (Assurant certificate): up to $1,000 per claim for loss, theft, accidental damage or mechanical breakdown; a depreciation of 2% per completed month from purchase is deducted, then a deductible based on the pre-tax price ($25 up to $200; $50 to $400; $75 to $600; $100 above $600); maximum 1 claim in any 12 months and 2 in any 48 months across all Collabria accounts held; coverage starts on the later of 30 days after purchase and the first monthly wireless bill charged to the card, and ends 2 years after purchase; the insurer chooses repair or replacement with the same make/model or like kind and quality
insl.oth: Common Carrier Accident Insurance $1,000,000 (Desjardins family contract); 24/7 Travel Assistance. Price Protection (Conexus-hosted Assurant certificate for this family, 2018 vintage): an identical item bought in Canada and charged in full to the card that is advertised lower in Canada within 60 days — the difference is paid; differences under $10 are excluded; up to $100 per item and $500 per account per calendar year; maximum 3 identical items, one claim per item; excludes computers, phones and similar electronics, motorized vehicles, used or one-of-a-kind items, business items and liquidation/grey-market comparisons. Price protection does not appear in the 2021 national certificate; Hotel Burglary: Not included — not among the benefits enumerated in the filed summary/certificate

insl.med: Travel Emergency Medical: up to $5,000,000 per Insured Person for the first 15 consecutive days of a trip, for Insured Persons under age 65 only — coverage ends on the date the Insured Person turns 65, so there is no medical coverage at 65+. Insured Persons are the Primary Cardholder, their spouse, and dependent children travelling with them. No requirement to charge the trip to the card (eligibility is Canadian residency plus GHIP coverage). Pre-Existing Conditions as defined in the certificate (180-day look-back before departure) are excluded; automatic extension of up to 3 days applies in defined cases (medical emergency running past day 15, delayed carrier departure, or vehicle breakdown) (certificate of insurance, ABIC/ABLAC, Group Policies BNS092015 and TBL022026, effective February 28, 2026)
insl.trip: Trip Cancellation (true pre-departure cancellation) and Trip Interruption, when at least 75% of the Full Cost of Eligible Expenses for the trip is charged to the Account and/or paid with Scene+ points earned on the card: cancellation reimburses non-refundable Eligible Expenses up to $2,000 per Insured Person and $5,000 per Trip (the Insurer must be notified within 48 hours of the covered cause; rescheduling expenses are also covered); interruption is up to $2,000 per Insured Person and $25,000 per Trip. Pre-Existing Conditions (180-day look-back before the date the trip was booked) are excluded (certificate of insurance)
insl.fd: Flight Delay: when at least 75% of the Full Cost of Eligible Expenses is charged to the Account and/or paid with Scene+ points earned on the card, a flight departure delay of 4 hours or more reimburses reasonable and necessary expenses (lodging, meals, refreshments, Essential Items) at $250 per 24 hours for a maximum of 48 hours, overall maximum $500 per Trip for all Insured Persons; no benefit if alternative transportation is made available within 4 hours of the scheduled departure (certificate of insurance)
insl.bag: Baggage Delay or Loss: when at least 75% of the Full Cost of Eligible Expenses is charged to the Account and/or paid with Scene+ points earned on the card — Baggage Delay: up to $500 per Trip for Essential Items when checked baggage is not delivered within 4 hours of arrival at the destination (not payable on the return to the home province/territory); Baggage Loss, Theft or Damage: replacement cost up to $1,000 per Insured Person per Trip, with a maximum of $500 for any one item or set of items; benefits are in excess of other insurance (certificate of insurance)
insl.cdw: Rental Car Collision/Loss Damage (CLD): primary insurance covering Direct Losses up to the actual cash value of the damaged or stolen rental vehicle, plus valid documented loss of use, reasonable towing and administration charges; rentals must not exceed 48 consecutive days (a longer rental voids coverage even for the first 48 days); the rental agency's CDW/LDW must be declined; the rental must be initiated with the card and the Full Cost charged to the Account and/or paid with Scene+ points; vehicles with an actual cash value over $85,000 are excluded, as are trucks, vans other than mini-vans, off-road vehicles, campers/trailers and expensive or exotic vehicles (certificate of insurance)
insl.pp: Purchase Assurance: 90 days from the date of purchase (or from delivery, if the item is delivered later) against loss, theft or damage, worldwide, when the Full Cost of the item is charged to the Account and/or paid with Scene+ points earned on the card; reimbursement of repair or replacement cost up to the item's original Full Cost; no per-incident dollar cap is stated; coverage is in excess of other insurance/protection; combined Purchase Assurance and Extended Warranty lifetime maximum liability of $60,000 (certificate of insurance)
insl.ew: Extended Warranty: doubles the period of repair services under the original manufacturer's warranty, up to 1 additional year, when the Full Cost of the item is charged to the Account and/or paid with Scene+ points earned on the card; automatic for manufacturer's warranties of less than 5 years; warranties of 5 years or more are covered only if the item is registered with the Insurer within 1 year after purchase; reimbursement up to the item's original Full Cost; combined Purchase Assurance and Extended Warranty lifetime maximum liability of $60,000 (certificate of insurance)
insl.mob: Mobile Device Insurance: up to $1,500 for loss, theft, mechanical breakdown or accidental damage of a new mobile device, paid as the depreciated value (2% depreciation per completed month from purchase) less a deductible of $25 (device cost $0-$200), $50 ($200.01-$400), $75 ($400.01-$600) or $100 (over $600); coverage starts on the later of 30 days from purchase and the date the first monthly wireless bill payment is charged to the Account, and ends two years from purchase; maximum one claim in any 12 consecutive month period and two claims in any 48 consecutive month period; eligible when the device is bought outright on the card, or funded through a carrier plan with all monthly wireless bill payments charged to the Account (certificate of insurance)
insl.oth: Event Ticket Protection Insurance: reimbursement of the non-refundable portion of Event Tickets charged to the Account, up to $1,000 per occurrence, when a covered cause directly prevents the Cardholder from using the tickets (season tickets reimbursed on a prorated basis for the missed event). Hotel/Motel Burglary Insurance: up to $1,000 per occurrence for all Insured Persons combined, where there is evidence of forcible entry. Price protection: No — not offered (no price protection coverage in the certificate). No common-carrier travel accident coverage in the certificate.

bsnap.equity_commission: $0 commission on all stock trades online (unlimited), effective September 14, 2026 (BMO newsroom release); the schedule was $9.95 flat before that date.
bsnap.etf_commission: $0 commission on all ETF trades online, effective September 14, 2026.
bsnap.options_commission: $0 base commission + $0.90 per contract (reduced from $1.25), effective September 14, 2026.
bsnap.options_assignment_exercise: No assignment or exercise fees (BMO newsroom release, effective September 14, 2026).
bsnap.mutual_fund_commission: No commission to buy, sell or switch. Early redemption fee 1% (minimum $35 online, $43 agent-assisted) on funds held under 90 days; purchase minimums apply.
bsnap.fixed_income_commission: Bonds, T-bills, GICs and strip coupons: commission, if any, included in the quoted price. Exchange-traded bonds: $40 + $1.50/$1,000 par under $50,000; $40 + $1.00/$1,000 at $50,000+.
bsnap.transfer_out_fee: $0: the $150 transfer-out fee was eliminated effective September 14, 2026 as part of the removal of all brokerage account administrative fees (BMO newsroom release).
bsnap.deregistration_fee: $0: the $50 RRSP/RRIF deregistration fee was eliminated effective September 14, 2026 (same release).
bsnap.admin_fees: All brokerage account administration fees were eliminated effective September 14, 2026, including the former $100 annual fee on RRSP and LIRA accounts under $25,000, the $50 annual RESP fee under $25,000, the $25 quarterly fee on non-registered accounts under $15,000, the $25 internal transfer fee and the $25 HBP and LLP withdrawal fees.
bsnap.inactivity_fees: None (all account administration fees eliminated September 14, 2026).
bsnap.minimums_waivers: No minimum balance required to open a Self-Directed account.
bsnap.account_types: Registered: TFSA, FHSA, RRSP, RESP, RRIF. Non-registered: individual, joint, cash or margin. Locked-in: LIRA, LRSP, RLSP, LRIF, LIF. Non-personal: trusts, estates, associations, corporations, investment clubs, partnerships and personal holding companies.
bsnap.asset_classes: Stocks, ETFs, options (including multi-leg), CDRs, mutual funds, GICs and bonds; gold and silver trading is offered (its fees sit in BMO's commission and fee schedule).
bsnap.usd_accounts: CAD and USD accounts, including registered accounts (except RESPs).
bsnap.market_access: Major North American exchanges (TSX, NYSE and NASDAQ named on the product page).
bsnap.fx_conversion: BMO acts as principal and earns revenue on each conversion by USD transaction size: under $25,000 220 bps (about 1.6%); $25,000-$74,999.99 130 bps (0.9%); $75,000-$99,999.99 105 bps (0.8%); $100,000-$249,999.99 75 bps (0.5%); $250,000+ no more than 55 bps (0.4%).
bsnap.margin_offered: Margin accounts offered; margin buying power is calculated in real time on the Active Trader platform.
bsnap.margin_rates: Self-directed (non 5 Star): CAD 6.00% at every balance; USD 9.00% under $100,000, 8.75% at $100,000+. 5 Star clients: CAD from 6.00% down to 5.25% (Diamond, $100,000+). BMO prime C$ 4.45%, US$ 7.00%.
bsnap.margin_requirements: Long: common stock 30% if reduced-margin or options-eligible, else 50%; preferred 35% / 60%; rights and warrants 50%; 2x+ leveraged ETFs/ETNs and stocks under $2.00 100%. Short: 130% of market if reduced-margin eligible, else 150%; 175% above CDN$200,000; under $2.00 cannot be shorted. Bonds 5% to 25% by issuer type.
bsnap.shorting: Short selling offered in margin accounts; stocks under $2.00 cannot be shorted.
bsnap.cash_interest: Self-directed cash, margin and registered accounts pay 0.00% on CAD and USD credit balances; 5 Star Diamond earns US$ 0.25% in cash and margin accounts.
bsnap.partner_benefits: 5-Star Program (15+ trades per quarter or $250,000+ invested): preferred rates and pricing, industry research and dedicated support.
bsnap.unique_feature: First of Canada's five largest bank-owned brokerages to eliminate commissions on all stock and ETF trades (BMO's published claim); paper trading is offered on BMO Active Trader.

bsnap.equity_commission: Penny-per-share: 1 cent per share with a minimum of $1.99 and a maximum of $7.99 per trade (published homepage summary). Active trader pricing (150+ commission-generating trades in the previous calendar quarter): $3.99 flat per equities trade.
bsnap.etf_commission: ETF purchases are commission-free provided the ETF is held at least one business day; ETF sales price on the penny schedule.
bsnap.options_commission: Standard $7.99 per trade + $1.25 per contract; active trader $3.99 + $1.25 per contract.
bsnap.mutual_fund_commission: No fees for mutual fund transactions; mutual funds with trailer fees cannot be purchased. Fund companies may pass through early-redemption or switch fees.
bsnap.fixed_income_commission: Exchange-traded debentures price at $24.99 + $1 per $1,000 par value per side; fixed-income securities trade free of commission on an agency basis in the published fee summaries.
bsnap.transfer_out_fee: Full account transfer out $150 per account; partial $50 per account.
bsnap.deregistration_fee: Full $50, partial $25; LLP, HBP and FHSA partial $25; TFSA withdrawals and RRIF minimum withdrawals free.
bsnap.admin_fees: $24.95 per quarter per account if combined assets are under $5,000 or no trade with at least $1.99 commission in the quarter; exempt under age 26, RESPs and registered charities. US-dollar registered accounts US$15 per quarter; RESP $25 per year.
bsnap.inactivity_fees: No separate inactivity fee; the $24.95/quarter administration fee applies without a qualifying trade or $5,000 in assets.
bsnap.minimums_waivers: No minimum cash balance to earn interest; administration fee waived at $5,000+ combined assets or one $1.99+ commission trade per quarter, and for clients under 26, RESPs and charities.
bsnap.account_types: Non-registered cash and margin accounts, corporate accounts, TFSA, RRSP, RESP, RRIF, LIRA and LIF, with dual currency (CAD and USD) available.
bsnap.asset_classes: Equities, ETFs, options, mutual funds, exchange-traded debentures and fixed-income securities.
bsnap.usd_accounts: Dual currency (CAD and USD) accounts are available.
bsnap.extended_hours: Orders placed pre-market or post-market carry an additional $0.0035 per share (anonymous, iceberg and bracketed orders carry the same surcharge).
bsnap.fx_conversion: Dual-currency (CAD/USD) accounts avoid forced conversions; no conversion rate or spread is published, and CI does not auto-convert to cover a deficit.
bsnap.norberts_gambit: Position journal $25 per the administrative fee table (the gambit itself is not described).
bsnap.margin_rates: CAD prime + 1.5% and USD prime + 1.5% on margin debit balances; registered-account debits prime + 7.5%; overnight under-margin penalty CAD prime + 3%. Prime value not on the page.
bsnap.borrow_fees: Borrow fee on each short position: borrow rate x market value, minimum 2.5% a year, typically 2.5% to 100%.
bsnap.cash_interest: Paid on positive balances: CAD prime - 8%, USD prime - 9% (registered and non-registered); no minimum balance.
bsnap.unique_feature: The Virtual Brokers lineage survives as penny-per-share pricing capped at $7.99, and a one-business-day hold makes ETF purchases commission-free.

bsnap.equity_commission: $6.95 per online stock or ETF trade (Canadian and U.S.); $4.95 active trader pricing at 150+ trades per quarter; $0 for clients 18 to 24 with a CIBC Smart Start chequing account; $5.95 for students 25 and over.
bsnap.etf_commission: $6.95 per trade on the standard schedule; over 180 ETFs trade with $0 commission.
bsnap.options_commission: $6.95 + $1.25 per contract; active trader $4.95 + $1.25 per contract.
bsnap.mutual_fund_commission: Money market mutual funds $0; all other mutual funds $6.95 per trade.
bsnap.fixed_income_commission: Commissions for fixed income and money market instruments are included in the price or yield and are disclosed on the order entry screen and on the trade confirmation.
bsnap.admin_fees: Annual account fee of $100 where the total market balance of all accounts is $10,000 or less; $0 above $10,000. FHSA accounts have no annual fee.
bsnap.minimums_waivers: New Investor's Edge clients are exempt from first-year fees; the annual fee is waived (up to $200) for clients 18 to 24 with CIBC Smart Start; no minimum balance.
bsnap.account_types: RRSP, TFSA, RESP, FHSA, LIRA, RRIF, LIF, non-registered cash and margin, and corporate accounts.
bsnap.asset_classes: Stocks, ETFs, options, mutual funds, fixed income and money market instruments, GICs.
bsnap.drip: A dealer DRIP (Sharebuilder plan) is offered with no commissions; dividends buy additional full shares and any remainder stays as cash.
bsnap.usd_accounts: Accounts hold CAD and USD balances (the published interest-rate table prices both currencies).
bsnap.ipo_access: IPOs listed among Investor's Edge investment products; no terms on the pricing page.
bsnap.margin_offered: Margin borrowing is offered (non-registered debit balances are priced on the published ladder).

Short-sale minimum margin: 130% of market value at $5 and over, 150% at $3 to $4.99, 200% at $2 to $2.99, $3 per share at $1.50 to $1.99, 200% at $0.25 to $1.49, and 100% plus $0.25 per share under $0.25.

bsnap.usd_accounts: Trading accounts (Margin and Cash) and RRSPs, RIFs, RLSP, LRSP and TFSAs operate in both Canadian and U.S. dollars; RESP and RDSP accounts are Canadian-dollar only (TD Commission Schedule).
bsnap.market_access: Canadian and U.S. markets; real-time quotes for Canadian and U.S. markets included.
bsnap.ipo_access: IPOs and new issues offered; no commission applies to new-issue expressions of interest.
bsnap.fx_conversion: DI Currency Conversion Spread by gross transaction amount: 1.26% under $25,000; 0.78% $25,000 to $99,999; 0.46% $100,000 to $499,999; 0.27% $500,000 to $999,999; 0.19% $1,000,000+. Applied on top of affiliate FX rates that include a surcharge of one-third of the spread.
bsnap.margin_rates: Margin borrowing is charged at TD's prevailing Canadian Prime (CAD) and/or U.S. Dollar Base Rate (USD) plus a specified spread set in TD's prevailing interest-rate schedule; the spread ladder itself was not captured in this pass.
bsnap.shorting: Short Selling accounts are offered (TD's Commission Schedule lists Short Selling Accounts among its trading accounts).
bsnap.cash_interest: Interest is paid on cash balances at TD Direct Investing's prevailing rates on the daily closing balance, paid monthly; no interest is payable on a closing credit balance in a short margin account, and no interest is paid where the monthly amount is under $5 per currency.
bsnap.unique_feature: Partial-share trading at a reduced $1.99 commission; TD Advanced Dashboard premium data unlocks at 30+ trades per quarter or $500,000 in household assets.

bsnap.equity_commission: $0 commission on stocks and ETFs at every client status (Core, Premium, Generation).
bsnap.options_commission: U.S.-listed options: $0 USD per contract at every client status (published status comparison). Options exercise and assignment fees were not captured.
bsnap.options_assignment_exercise: Assignment $0; auto-exercise US$0; early exercise US$45; do-not-exercise instruction US$45.
bsnap.futures_commission: Futures offered: US$1 per contract, plus NFA fee US$0.02 per contract and the exchange fee passed through.
bsnap.transfer_out_fee: $0 for outgoing account transfers to another institution.
bsnap.admin_fees: Account opening $0 and account closing $0; optional USD Account $10 + tax per month.
bsnap.account_types: Non-registered cash and margin, TFSA, RRSP (including spousal), FHSA, RESP, LIRA and RRIF; crypto sits in separate crypto accounts.
bsnap.asset_classes: Canadian and U.S. stocks and ETFs, U.S. options, and crypto (in separate crypto accounts). Mutual funds are not part of the self-directed lineup.
bsnap.fractional_shares: Fractional orders supported for stocks and ETFs (market orders only), minimum order $1.00; not available for cryptocurrencies. Fractional orders placed during extended hours, and those arising from dividend reinvestment or recurring investments, are not instant.
bsnap.drip: Dividend reinvestment is offered (fractional DRIP orders are not instant, per the fractional-orders help article).
bsnap.usd_accounts: USD accounts: $10 per month for Core clients; included free (opt-in) for Premium ($100,000+) and Generation ($500,000+) clients. Holding USD avoids per-trade conversion.
bsnap.extended_hours: Extended-hours trading is offered (fractional orders placed in extended hours are not instant).
bsnap.fx_conversion: With USD accounts, per transaction: 1.50% under $10,000; 1.00% from $10,000 to $24,999.99; 0.50% from $25,000 to $99,999.99; 0% at $100,000 and over. Without USD accounts the fee is 1.50% on all conversions. The fee applies on top of Wealthsimple's corporate exchange rate, which itself includes a spread.
bsnap.norberts_gambit: Journaling fee $9.95 per the trade fee schedule (the gambit itself is not described).
bsnap.margin_offered: Margin accounts offered (borrowing in CAD and USD).
bsnap.margin_rates: Set off Wealthsimple Prime by client status: Core Prime + 0.5%, Premium Prime + 0%, Generation Prime - 0.5%. Published primes at capture: CAD 4.45%, USD 7.00%, so CAD margin costs 4.95% (Core), 4.45% (Premium) and 3.95% (Generation). Interest accrues daily and is posted monthly; balances stay in the currency of the securities purchased.
bsnap.shorting: No short-selling facility is published; the margin documentation covers long borrowing only.
bsnap.securities_lending: Stock lending (opt-in; opt-out in settings, termination can take up to five business days): clients lend shares, and loan confirmations show the weighted-average loan rate per security and currency. Some loans are placed at a 0% rebate where Wealthsimple earns interest on the cash collateral instead and shares a portion of that interest income with the lender; the client pays no fees in the process.
bsnap.partner_benefits: Client statuses reprice the platform: Core (from $1 in assets), Premium ($100,000+), Generation ($500,000+). Status perks include partner milestone rewards (0 for Core, 0 to 3 for Premium, 3 for Generation), 20% off Willful for Premium and Generation, and Medcan discounts in Ontario (Year-Round Care 30% off Premium, 40% off Generation; Annual Health Assessment 20% and 30%).

bsnap.equity_commission: Zero-commission trading on U.S. and Canadian equities, launched April 13, 2026, across TFSA, RRSP, margin and cash accounts, replacing the earlier $2.99 per-trade schedule. Regulatory and exchange fees may still apply.
bsnap.etf_commission: $0 per trade on Canadian and U.S. ETFs (regulatory and exchange fees may apply).
bsnap.options_commission: US options: $0.99 USD per contract; clients who activate options on or after September 22, 2026 get the contract fee refunded for the first 3 months (regulatory and exchange fees may apply).
bsnap.futures_commission: Not offered: no commodity futures or futures options.
bsnap.fixed_income_commission: Not offered: no bonds or debentures.
bsnap.transfer_in_reimbursement: Transfer-fee reimbursement up to $300 CAD total: one for a cash or margin account and one for a registered account; minimum transfer $2,000 CAD; paid 2 to 5 business days after settlement (claim in My Rewards).
bsnap.admin_fees: Account maintenance fee: C$0.70/month on all trading accounts, effective June 2026 (Webull announcement email to account holders, 2026-05-27; VERIFIED 2026-10-14 from the filed Gmail evidence note).
bsnap.minimums_waivers: No minimum to earn cash interest ("$0 fees & no minimums"); margin requires $2,000 minimum equity.
bsnap.account_types: TFSA, RRSP, margin and cash accounts (the zero-commission launch scope).
bsnap.asset_classes: U.S. and Canadian equities; options trading and crypto trading have been added to the Canadian platform since the equity launch (published launch material). The current Canadian options per-contract price was not captured from a Webull Canada page in this pass.
bsnap.market_access: Canadian and U.S. listed equities and ETFs, and U.S. options.
bsnap.extended_hours: Overnight session 8 pm to 4 am ET, Sunday to Friday, for select stocks and ETFs (24/5 trading).
bsnap.ipo_access: None: Webull does not distribute new issues (no IPOs or secondary offerings).
bsnap.fx_conversion: Webull may act as principal and convert at rates set by it or related parties, earning revenue on the conversion; no rate or spread is published.
bsnap.margin_offered: Margin accounts with up to 2x leverage on Canadian and U.S. buying power; minimum equity $2,000 plus other eligibility requirements.
bsnap.margin_rates: Prime + 3.00% or Prime + 2.00%, CAD and USD alike, tiered at a $100,000 margin balance (the page states rates are lower for larger balances). Prime value not on the page.
bsnap.borrow_fees: Not applicable: short selling is not permitted.
bsnap.cash_interest: 1.00% on settled CAD and USD cash in cash and margin accounts (rate as of October 1, 2025; may change).
bsnap.unique_feature: Zero-commission equity trading launched April 13, 2026, on an app-first platform whose detailed fee schedule is published primarily in-app.
